Maiden name appears in St. Nicholas Church records as "Lechiw".

Shown on page 107 of Volume 15, Baptisms for St. Nicholas Ukrainian Catholic Church, Winnipeg, Manitoba on August 19, 1917.

Godparents were Joannes (John) Lesyk and Anna Kyprian.

Rev. A. Filipow O.S.B.M. officiated.

Birthdate on church marriage records indicate "July 26, 1917", and not "July 25, 1917" as given on Baptism records of August 19, 1917.

Possibly worked at Henderson Manufacturing and resided at 536 Ross Avenue in 1946.

Married name may have been changed to "Katan" (as per her mother Catherine's obituary).

ALICE KAZAN (nee LECHOW) Peacefully on July 18, 2003, Alice Kazan passed away at Seven Oaks Hospital at the age of 85 after a short illness. Alice will be lovingly remembered by her daughter Christine Thullner; grandchildren, Allison (Toronto) and Paul (Winnipeg) Thullner; sisters-in-law, Anne Lechow (Lubbock, Texas), Jenny Nitchuk (Winnipeg) and Laurel Kazan (Lethbridge, AB) and several nieces and nephews. She was predeceased by her parents, Dmytro and Catherine Lechow; her husband Harry in 1984 and her brother Dr. Bohdan Lechow of Lubbock, Texas. Alice was born July 26, 1917 and was educated in Winnipeg. Her whole life revolved around her family, especially her two grandchildren. The family would like to thank the doctors, nurses and healthcare workers of 3U4 Seven Oaks Hospital for the excellent care given to our mother and grandmother and the compassion shown to the family. Prayers will be sung 7:00 p.m., Monday, July 21 at Korban Funeral Chapel, 907 Main St. Divine Liturgy will be celebrated 9:30 a.m., Tuesday, July 22 at Blessed Virgin Mary Ukrainian Catholic Church, 965 Boyd Ave. with Rev. G. Oucharyk officiating. Interment will follow in Holy Family Cemetery. In lieu of flowers, if friends so desire, a donation may be made to a charity of their choice. VICHNAYA PAMYAT KORBAN FUNERAL CHAPEL 956-2193

As published in Winnipeg Free Press on Jul 20, 2003
